description: Kenya Electricity Transmission Network and Generation Expansion Analysis Using OpenTEPES is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This dataset includes all openTEPES Input and results files for the Kenya Electricity Expansion Plan analysis for 2030, 2040, and 2050. The analysis identified the investment requirements for the transmission and generation expansion plan, driven by expected demand and the goal of maintaining ecosystem harmony, as an extension of the country's Vision 2030 and 2060. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
